name: media-between-text
title: Media Between Text
description: A sentence with a gap in the middle: a rounded media tile springs open between the two halves, pushing the words apart, then closes again. The tile is a drawn gradient by default, or your own image.
useWhen: A line of text should open a gap and show a picture, clip or swatch inline, as part of the sentence.
A headline needs an image tucked between its words, appearing with a spring.
avoidWhen: The picture should fill the frame or sit in a separate layout: use a scene or panel block.
The text must not shift while the media appears.
author: Daniel Petho

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. The row shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Media width
variables.description: Width of the opened media tile, in em of the font size.

variables.label: Media height
variables.description: Height of the media tile, in em of the font size.

variables.label: Media radius
variables.description: Corner radius of the tile, in em.

variables.label: Gradient from
variables.description: First color of the drawn tile.

variables.label: Gradient to
variables.description: Second color of the drawn tile.

variables.label: Image
variables.description: Optional image path (for example assets/media/upl_xxx.jpg) drawn over the gradient, cover-fitted. Empty keeps the drawn gradient.

variables.label: Close at
variables.description: Seconds when the tile closes again. 0 keeps it open.

variables.label: Spring duration
variables.description: Perceived duration of the opening spring.
